Udacity Data Analyst A/B-testing project.

Evaluating a proposed landing-page change

A practical exercise in conversion-rate experiments, simulation and regression.

Python · pandas · NumPy · statsmodels · Matplotlib

The question

A new page should be evaluated with evidence rather than assumed to improve conversion.

The work

  • Clean assignment and landing-page records.
  • Simulate a null distribution of conversion-rate differences.
  • Fit logistic regression and explore country/page interactions.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Notebook includes a saved null-distribution plot with the observed difference marked.

What I learned

  • Connect hypothesis testing to a product decision and interpret uncertainty carefully.

Project context

  • Learning exercise; no live business experiment or conversion uplift claimed.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
